title: Bihar Youths Skating to Deoghar Baba Dham Yatra Goes Viral
summary: A group of youths from Bihar are skating to Deoghar Baba Dham as part of a unique pilgrimage. The 420-kilometer journey is being completed on skates, with the pilgrims aiming to reach the destination by the end of the monsoon season. The youths claim that this year's yatra will be more challenging due to the heavy rainfall in the region. The police have set up checkpoints along the highway to ensure the safety of the pilgrims.
summary_points: A group of Bihar youths are skating to Deoghar Baba Dham as part of a unique pilgrimage.
